sources.title: Specification 700-713–16: Pressure Sensitive Adhesive Labels for Plastic and Metal Substrates for Use in Thermal Transfer Printers
sources.version_or_release: Specification 700-713–16; revision history records 2016-09-30 changes; current index calls this the most recent posted PDF. No commit identifier.
sources.locator: Scope and §§1.1–1.2, PDF p. 1; §§2.4–2.7, PDF pp. 1–3; packaging §4.1 and revision history §5.5, PDF p. 6.
sources.critic_recheck_utc_window: 2026-10-10T06:12:11Z–2026-10-10T06:21:32Z; web tool exposed no per-request fetch timestamp.
sources.observed_operation: Investigator record: opened/read official PDF. Critic independently reopened PDF and checked scope, adhesive, bond/curl/print procedures, test panel conditions, and change history.
sources.governing_conditions_defaults_exceptions: LOC purchasing; plastic/metal collection storage containers; thermal-transfer printer; excludes rare/high-value and photographic uses; disclaims commercial endorsement. It specifies face stock selected by user, vendor-compatible ribbon and identified printer. Initial bond uses a 7-day dwell at 23°C/50% RH; accelerated bond and curl/lift exposure is 80°C/50% RH for 28 days, followed by 24 hours at 23°C/50% RH for bond testing. It separately evaluates bond, curl/lift/ooze, print fastness, and abrasion. §2.5 also states a performance requirement for normal use over the life of the object, but the accelerated protocol itself gives no storage-year conversion.
sources.applicability: A procurement/test-design and traceability precedent only. It provides no case-specific suitability, safety endorsement, acceptance threshold, or lifetime conversion.

sources.version_or_release: Specification 700-703–16; revision history records 2016-09-30 changes; no commit identifier.
sources.locator: Scope and §§1.1–1.2, PDF p. 1; §§2.4–2.6 and 3.5–3.7, PDF pp. 1–4; package identification §4.1 and revision history §5.5, PDF pp. 5–6.

sources.observed_operation: Investigator record: opened/reviewed official PDF. Critic independently reopened PDF and checked scope, acrylic adhesive/permanence language, product requirements, package/batch identifiers, and version history.
sources.governing_conditions_defaults_exceptions: LOC purchasing; labels for plastic/metal storage containers; laser printer; excludes rare/high-value and photographic materials. §1.2 specifies high-permanence acrylic PSA intended to remain permanently affixed and be removable only with difficulty. Inner packages identify supplier/manufacturer, year and manufacturing batch. Shelf-life conditions apply to compliant products under ambient storage.

sources.title: Lindner, Factors affecting the hygroexpansion of paper
sources.version_or_release: Published online 2017-08-01; Journal of Materials Science 53 (2018), 1–26; DOI 10.1007/s10853-017-1358-1.
sources.locator: Abstract; sections on sheet hygroexpansion and Fiber orientation, especially discussion of machine/cross direction and process parameters.
sources.critic_recheck_utc_window: 2026-10-10T06:12:11Z–2026-10-10T06:21:32Z; web tool exposed no per-request fetch timestamp.
sources.observed_operation: Investigator record: opened publisher page and reviewed metadata/full-text sections. Critic reopened publisher text, searched cross-direction and inspected fiber-orientation and drying-process passages.
sources.governing_conditions_defaults_exceptions: Review synthesizes papers, grades and manufacturing processes. Its summarized directional relationships vary with fiber orientation, sheet structure, drying conditions, and other parameters; it does not characterize the case label stock.
sources.applicability: Supports recording direction where known and separating dimensional measurements by direction. It does not predict the case stock's movement or identify its grain direction.

sources.title: Maass & Hirn, Long term curl of printing paper due to ink solvent migration
sources.version_or_release: Materials & Design 237 (January 2024), article 112593; DOI 10.1016/j.matdes.2023.112593; no commit identifier.
sources.locator: Publisher abstract, experiment description and conclusion.

Critic's direct open returned an internal error; a ScienceDirect-domain search result displayed article metadata, highlights, abstract and method description. Full text remains uninspected.
sources.governing_conditions_defaults_exceptions: The abstract describes A4 sheets sprayed with a water/glycerol model ink, curl measurement by 2D laser sensor, and glycerol distribution measured by sheet splitting/HPLC. It proposes a mechanism for inkjet-printed sheets.
sources.applicability: A conditional hypothesis only if the actual printer/ink resembles the model system. It does not establish the unknown case printer or the case cause.

sources.observed_operation: Investigator record: opened official guidance. Critic reopened relevant sections and inspected eligibility, static/media-transfer warnings, one-sided bond-paper support, and copy/supervisor conditions.
sources.governing_conditions_defaults_exceptions: Guidance concerns paper records and polyester L-sleeves. It says to sleeve only damaged records needing support or small records at risk of loss; static can displace media and some media can offset onto plastics. Bond paper may remain for extra support for a one-sided document in the L-sleeve context. Copy/facsimile recommendations and supervisor consultation concern specified unstable/acidic records and original handling.
sources.applicability: Context only for a non-adhesive record/insert alternative. It does not establish that a loose card or insert is appropriate for the case's unidentified sleeves or collection contents.
